name: La Raza Centro Legal
description: Free legal services in immigration, workers' rights, and elder and disability law for Latino and immigrant communities
fullDescription: La Raza Centro Legal provides free legal services and advocacy to Latino and immigrant communities in San Francisco, specializing in immigration, workers' rights, and elder and disability law.
whatTheyOffer:
- Affirmative immigration services (applications such as citizenship and green cards)
- Immigration removal (deportation) defense and asylum
- Workers' rights for low-wage and immigrant workers
- Elder & Disability Law Program for SF residents 60+ or adults 19–59 with a disability (SSI/SSDI appeals, simple wills and trusts, advance health care directives, powers of attorney, debt collection defense)
- Bilingual services (English/Spanish)
howToGetIt:
1. Call the front desk at 415-575-3500 or email info@lrcl.org
2. Must meet program eligibility guidelines
3. Complete intake screening
4. Receive legal advice or representation
address: 474 Valencia Street, Suite 295, San Francisco, CA 94103
keywords: La Raza, San Francisco, immigration, deportation defense, asylum, workers rights, elder law, disability, SSI, wills, Latino, Mission District, Spanish, free legal
